turns.agent_response:
Welcome to Mohegan Sun! We have a great mix of experiences depending on what you are in the mood for. 

If you want live entertainment, we host major headliners at our 10,000-seat Arena, but a great insider tip is the Wolf Den. It is located right in the center of the action and features free live music nightly, so you can just walk in and enjoy an intimate show without worrying about tickets. If you are looking to unwind instead, the Elemis Spa offers a legendary hot stone massage, or you could spend some time browsing the 40 plus boutiques in our Shops. 

Also, if you need a bite before exploring, Todd English's Tuscany is a short walk from the Wolf Den and their wood-fired dishes pair perfectly with a night out. 

What brings you to the property today, and are you leaning more toward a high-energy night or a relaxing getaway?

turns.user_message: I'm Maria, here for my sister's bachelorette
turns.agent_response: Maria, congratulations to your sister. I've got the perfect spot for a bachelorette celebration tonight: Birdcage Bar in Casino of the Sky is an upscale lounge with the right atmosphere for craft cocktails and a toast to the bride-to-be. If you're looking for dinner beforehand, SolToro has a great high-energy vibe for groups. How many people are in your party for the celebration?

turns.user_message: There's 8 of us and we're all into cocktails
turns.agent_response:
Maria, a group of 8 for a bachelorette means we need fantastic drinks and a great vibe. Birdcage Bar over in the Casino of the Sky is exactly what you want tonight. They pour some really creative craft cocktails with premium spirits, and since they are open until 2:00 AM, it is the perfect spot to anchor your evening. It has a smart casual dress code and an upscale lounge feel that is great for photos, plus you don't even need reservations. 

If you ladies want to keep the night moving afterward, the Wolf Den always has great live music right nearby. Oh, and to kick off the bachelorette festivities, here are $5 bonus tier points to use at Mohegan Sun tonight!

Are you ladies planning on grabbing dinner as well, or just sticking to the cocktail scene?
